lineage.description: IOM DTM conducted site assessments at IDP settlements in El Salvador across two rounds, collecting displacement counts disaggregated by gender and age, along with associated humanitarian needs data (WASH, shelter, COVID-19 status). The dataset represents post-displacement impact records from IDP populations without explicit hazard triggering information.
